inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Caregivers Must Wear Gloves When Handling Blood or Bodily Fluids: Caregiver did not wear gloves when handling a child's cut that was bleeding.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Caregivers Must Wear Gloves When Handling Blood or Bodily Fluids (26 TAC §746.3425(1))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions: Van U40 721 did not have a working child safety alarm.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions (26 TAC §746.5625(b))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: The director and three drivers did not have two hours of transportation training it was only an hour.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The operation did not have a current health inspection, the last one conducted was 3-17-2025 or the operation did not have a letter stating they did not need an health inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: Four child that had a listed food allergy did ot have a allergy planned signed by a heath care professional .
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Reduction of child/caregiver naptime ratio by 50% allowed, If 13 or more children in care, children are 18 mo. or older and other standards met: Based on the information provided throughout the investigation they will be cited for being out of ratio on February 2nd and 9th one caregiver had seven children specify age group 12-17 months old the caregiver was over by two children. On April 27 a caregiver had 12 children specify age group 12-17 months old, one caregiver should have had five children, they were over ratio seven children. Raito cannot be reduced for infants during naptime.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Reduction of child/caregiver naptime ratio by 50% allowed, If 13 or more children in care, children are 18 mo. or older and other standards met (26 TAC §746.1613(a))

occurrences.finding: No Swaddling of Infant Unless Completed Sleep Exception Form on File: A infant in a crib was swaddled while sleeping.
occurrences.violation_type_title: No Swaddling of Infant Unless Completed Sleep Exception Form on File (26 TAC §746.2428)

occurrences.finding: Substitutes, volunteers, and contractors counted in ratio: A contract worked that was counted into ratio did not have the required documentation as a employee/caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Substitutes, volunteers, and contractors counted in ratio (26 TAC §746.1401(c))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: Caregiver stated they had 15 children when CCR inspector counted it was 16 children in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions: A contract worker  was observed supervising a group of children in the infant classroom ages 2 to 5 years old, even though the background check had conditions prohibit for them to not supervise children alone.     Corrected:  When the contract worker left for the day.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions (26 TAC §745.635(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912): Four employees did not have pre-employment affidavit form 2912.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements: Two employees did not have proof of education on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements (26 TAC §746.901(2))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2024, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2024 by January 15, 2025, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Limitations or Restrictions: Based on the information obtained the operation did not have special care needs statement on the children's file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Limitations or Restrictions (26 TAC §746.605(12)(A))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on the information obtained, it was determined that good judgment was not used when a caregiver left a pair of adult scissors to the reach of the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: The child?s parent was not provided with an incident report within 48 hours of when the incident occurred.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on the information gathered during the investigation, proper supervision was not maintained, and as a result, a child was injured.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, the operation did not provide an incident report to the parent within 48 hours after the incident occurred.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Unassigned Epinephrine Auto-Injectors: There was no policy for the operation to maintains and administers unassigned epinephrine auto- injectors.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Unassigned Epinephrine Auto-Injectors (26 TAC §746.501(a)(29))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records: Six training records were not available to review during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §746.801(3))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Benefits: The promotion of the indoor and outdoor policies was not available to review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Benefits (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18)(A))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services: The operational policies does not have procedures for supporting inclusive services to children with special care needs
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services (26 TAC §746.501(a)(30))

occurrences.finding: Corrections Made to Fire Inspection: The operation has not made corrections on some items reviewed in the last fire marshal report from 8/31/23.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Corrections Made to Fire Inspection (26 TAC §746.5105)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Caregivers failed to notice a child in care sustained a serious injury.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Critical Injury - Give First Aid or CPR: A caregiver failed to administer first aid when a child sustained a burn.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Critical Injury - Give First Aid or CPR (26 TAC §746.3607(2))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Fire Inspection: The operation did not have a copy of their most recent fire inspection report.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Fire Inspection (26 TAC §746.5103)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: The caregivers inside the infant and 2 year old classrooms did not know the correct number of children in their care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))
